bio.text: Dr. Amy Chai, a physician, announced in January 2026 that she would run as a Republican for Connecticut's 1st Congressional District, held by Democrat John Larson since 1999.

According to her campaign website, she attended Johns Hopkins University (biology), Indiana University School of Medicine (M.D.), the University of Michigan Medical Center (internal medicine) and the University of Virginia Health Sciences Center, where she earned an MS in epidemiology.
The site describes her as an expert in primary care and addiction medicine.

sources.title: Republican Chai to run for Congress in CT's first district
